description.message: Shows every connection the browser makes by itself, why it exists and how to turn it off. Read-only, fully local.

c_lead.message: Every connection the browser makes on its own, without you opening a site: who receives it, why, and how to turn it off.

c_foot.message: This page shows Klin's default settings. If you changed a setting yourself in `about:config`, this page does not know. It makes no network requests.

c_ev_audit.message: Connection audit: seen (or confirmed absent) on the wire

c_ev_setting.message: Setting value only, not yet observed on the wire

c_loaderr.message: The connection list could not be loaded.

c_audit_method.message: Idle fresh profile, every request logged and refused by a local proxy (tests/baseline/connection-audit).

c_audit_limits.message: Entries marked 'pref' were not seen in the idle audit: they are browsing-time connections, switched off by a preference whose value was verified, not their absence on the wire.

e_remote_settings_purpose.message: Downloads security data: blocklists of harmful add-ons, certificate revocation data (CRLite), intermediate certificates.

e_remote_settings_sees.message: Your IP address and when the browser checks for new data. Not the sites you visit.

e_remote_settings_decision.message: Keep. Security data; Klin relies on CRLite instead of OCSP.

e_remote_settings_ifOff.message: Revoked certificates and harmful add-ons would no longer be detected.

e_remote_settings_note.message: No safe switch. Turning it off also disables certificate revocation checks.

e_updates_purpose.message: Checks for and downloads new browser versions.

e_updates_sees.message: Your IP address, browser version, operating system and language.

e_updates_decision.message: Keep. Timely security updates are mandatory (specification 4.5).

e_updates_ifOff.message: Known security holes stay open until you update by hand.

e_safe_browsing_purpose.message: Downloads lists of known phishing and malware sites. Pages are checked against the local copy.

e_safe_browsing_sees.message: Your IP address and when the lists are refreshed. Not the sites you visit.

e_safe_browsing_decision.message: Keep, user-switchable (decided 13 Nov 2026). Google sees your IP address and when the lists refresh; checks against the lists happen on your machine.

e_safe_browsing_ifOff.message: No warning on known phishing and malware pages.

e_addon_updates_purpose.message: Checks installed extensions for updates and fetches their descriptions.

e_addon_updates_sees.message: Your IP address and the list of installed extensions.

e_addon_updates_decision.message: Keep while extensions are installed: extension updates are security updates.

e_addon_updates_ifOff.message: Extensions, including the ad blocker, stop receiving fixes.

e_amo_install_purpose.message: First start only: downloads uBlock Origin, as required by the Klin policy.

e_amo_install_sees.message: Your IP address and that uBlock Origin is being installed.

e_amo_install_decision.message: Remove by bundling uBlock Origin in the build.

e_amo_install_ifOff.message: No ad and tracker blocking until uBlock Origin is installed another way.

e_amo_install_note.message: Goes away once uBlock Origin ships inside Klin.

e_ubo_lists_purpose.message: Updates the lists of ads, trackers, malware domains and cookie banners to block or hide.

e_ubo_lists_sees.message: Your IP address and when the lists are refreshed. Not the sites you visit.

e_ubo_lists_decision.message: Keep. Blocking quality depends on fresh lists (specification 4.2).

e_ubo_lists_ifOff.message: Blocking slowly gets worse as lists age.

e_ubo_lists_note.message: In the uBlock Origin dashboard. The cookie-notice lists are switched on by Klin's policy and are not bundled: they are only downloaded.

e_ubo_lists_operator.message: uBlock Origin project and list maintainers (hosted on GitHub, Cloudflare, jsDelivr, GitLab)

e_push_purpose.message: Keeps a permanent connection open so sites can send notifications while closed.

e_push_sees.message: Your IP address, all the time the browser is running.

e_push_decision.message: Disabled. A permanent background connection is against low impact.

e_push_note.message: Set both to true to re-enable.

e_region_purpose.message: Guesses your country to choose regional defaults such as the search engine.

e_region_sees.message: Your IP address, from which the country is derived.

e_region_ifOff.message: Regional defaults are not adjusted automatically.

e_region_note.message: Set the first to true and reset the second to re-enable.

e_captive_portal_purpose.message: Pings a test page to detect Wi-Fi login pages (hotels, trains) and whether the network works.

e_captive_portal_sees.message: Your IP address, repeatedly, on every network you join.

e_captive_portal_ifOff.message: Public Wi-Fi login pages are not opened automatically; open any http page to reach them.

e_captive_portal_note.message: Set both to true to re-enable.

e_openh264_purpose.message: Downloads a video codec used for H.264 in video calls.

e_openh264_ifOff.message: Video calls that only offer H.264 may not work. Normal video playback is not affected.

e_accounts_purpose.message: Sign-in and synchronisation through a Mozilla account.

e_accounts_sees.message: Your IP address and, when signed in, your account.

e_accounts_note.message: Also locked by the DisableFirefoxAccounts policy.

e_ocsp_purpose.message: Asks the authority that issued a site's certificate whether it has been revoked.

e_ocsp_sees.message: Your IP address and which site you are opening, usually over unencrypted HTTP.

e_ocsp_decision.message: Disabled. Revocation is checked locally with CRLite.

e_ocsp_ifOff.message: A certificate not covered by CRLite gets no revocation check.

e_search_suggestions_purpose.message: Sends what you type in the address bar to the search engine to show suggestions, and asks it for trending searches when you click the bar.

e_search_suggestions_sees.message: Your IP address and every character typed, before you press Enter.

e_search_suggestions_decision.message: Disabled. Nothing is sent until you search.

e_search_suggestions_ifOff.message: No suggestions from the search engine while typing.

e_search_suggestions_note.message: Set both to true to re-enable.

e_speculative_purpose.message: Connects in advance to sites you might open next, to save a moment if you do.

e_speculative_sees.message: Your IP address, on sites you never chose to visit.

e_speculative_ifOff.message: The first load of a new site can be slightly slower.

e_speculative_note.message: See config/prefs/klin.js for the Klin values.

e_promo_services_purpose.message: Fetches sponsored shortcuts, recommended articles, add-on recommendations and VPN promotions, and downloads models for Firefox's own on-device AI features.

e_promo_services_sees.message: Your IP address and that you opened a new tab or the add-ons page.

e_promo_services_decision.message: Disabled. Klin shows no advertising or sponsored content (specification 6); its AI is opt-in and uses local Ollama (specification 4.8).

e_promo_services_ifOff.message: No sponsored or recommended content, no Firefox AI features such as smart tab groups.

e_promo_services_note.message: Set to true to re-enable. Destinations beyond contile.services.mozilla.com not yet confirmed on the wire.

e_promo_services_name.message: Sponsored tiles, recommendations and built-in AI downloads
